evals.name: primary_sources_unavailable
evals.prompt: Plan this Django 5.2 to 6.0 upgrade. Network access is not available.
expect: Uses repository evidence that is available
Reports which current requirements it could not verify
Does not claim that unverified versions or dependencies are current

evals.name: unexpected_migration
evals.prompt: The Django upgrade produced a new migration even though I did not change the models.
expect: Runs or requests the migration check
Does not accept or regenerate the migration automatically
Requires an intentional model-state change before it keeps a new migration

evals.name: narrow_non_upgrade_task
evals.prompt: Fix this template typo in a Django 6 project.
expect: Does not invoke the Django upgrade workflow
Does not perform dependency or migration work
Keeps the change limited to the typo
